plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-10 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Management (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Management Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Management (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed July 27, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S.: the catalog prints Total Credits, B.S. Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; the B.A. carries a 16-credit foreign-language requirement that the map expressly does not include. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/14/15/15/15/15/15/15) and the plan to 120. Cross-check: the catalog's Management Curriculum totals 77.5 credits (Pre-Business Foundation 23, Additional Business Requirements 9, Business Core 18.5 including the 0.5-credit BA 4999 Assurance of Learning, Management Core 27), and every named curriculum course appears in the map, including the map's 9 credits of upper-division MGMT electives and 6 credits of upper-division business electives. The catalog's Management Core requires one of MGMT 3020 Small Business Management or MGMT 3050 International Business; the map places MGMT 3050 in Year 3 Fall, transcribed as printed. Titles follow the map; where the catalog program page prints a different title it is disclosed here: MATH 1040 is 'Finite Mathematics' in the catalog, ACCT 2010 is 'Principles of Financial Accounting', FIN 3250 is 'Managerial Finance', and MKTG 3010 is 'Principles of Marketing'. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
